settings.title: 🔄 100% Quality Satisfaction Guarantee
settings.content: If your order arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, notify us within 48 hours of delivery for a hassle-free replacement or full refund.

settings.title: 1. Return & Refund Eligibility
settings.content:
Due to the perishable and food-grade nature of our organic farm products (cold-stone ground attas, A2 bilona ghee, unrefined oils), returns are accepted under the following conditions:

  • Product arrived damaged, leaked, or unsealed in transit
  • Incorrect item or weight received
  • Quality issue reported within 48 hours of delivery with photo/video proof

settings.title: 2. Non-Refundable Scenarios
settings.content:
Refunds or replacements cannot be issued for:

  • Opened or consumed food items without verified quality defect
  • Incorrect shipping address provided by the customer
  • Delivery delays caused by customer unavailability or incorrect contact number

settings.title: 3. Refund Processing Time
settings.content:
Once your refund request is approved:

  • Online Payments (UPI, Cards, NetBanking): Processed back to original source account within 5–7 business days.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD Orders): Refunded via Bank Transfer or UPI ID provided by the customer.

settings.title: 4. Order Cancellation Policy
settings.content: Orders can be cancelled before they are dispatched from our warehouse (usually within 4 hours of placing the order). Once dispatched, cancellation is no longer possible.
